lifecycleSupplement.source: w01/root fixed7106 read-only study; no product test or new scope
lifecycleSupplement.capture: controller/binding identity + snapshot.selected array token + detached deep-frozen refs; ordinary network/readiness publications preserve token, remove/reselect creates new token
lifecycleSupplement.handoff: Attach rejection handling, call send/enqueue and inspect public outbox/queue snapshot for an actual new matching receipt key. Consume once synchronously only if controller/binding/token still match; no receipt means no consumption.
lifecycleSupplement.consume: At most four existing remove operations without await after one token check; no create-only consumption. ACK/timeout/budget failure/retry never clears new refs or sets composer text.
lifecycleSupplement.asyncBoundary: A throw before first await still yields rejected Promise. Synchronous try/catch alone does not prove handoff. No-handoff validation may restore this draft once; published receipt failures must not become MessageNotSentError or unhandled rejection.
regressions: capture A then remove/reselect A, old commit/ACK cannot remove new A; body/readiness-only publication retains eligible token
delay old text+refs HTTP while entering new draft/refs, then budget400/unknown/ACK preserves new input; unknown retries old key+refs
async local failure without new receipt: zero HTTP, no ref consumption, restore once, no unhandled rejection; successful handoff immediately permits next draft
lifecycleSupplement.sdkLimit: sendGeneration changes only on sends, not ordinary input editing; it does not prevent old MessageNotSentError prepend into newer draft
